product.title: Stars Align Midi Dress
product.description: LIONESS Stars Align Midi Dress in Honey Check is a fully lined, lightweight chiffon dress in 100% polyester, with a neck self-tie closure and scalloped lace trim. The shoulder-to-hem length is approximately 61 inches. Hand wash; made in China.
